title: BLDC Current Controller
text: Discrete-time Brushless DC Motor current PI controller, 5 inputs, 1 output; {Proportional gain} sets the controller proportional gain, K p, {Integral gain}, {Anti-windup gain}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Discretization sample time} sets the sample time for discretization and {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero cancellation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Controller proportional gain, K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: Integral gain, K i 5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: Anti-windup gain, K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: Sample time for discretization 0.001 (default) | positive scalar
